semantics.p1y: (p1a AND p1b AND p1c) OR (p1d AND p1e AND p1f)
semantics.timing: Combinational gates, continuous outputs, no clock or latency. Evidence: original explicitly permits assign for each output.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified startup value; outputs follow inputs after combinational settling.

numeric.widths: All ports one bit as specified.
numeric.operators: Bitwise AND and OR implement gate truth tables including ordinary Verilog four-state propagation; no arithmetic.

verification.oracle: Independent truth-table gate functions based on the original two stated gate groupings.
verification.binary: Exhaust all 1024 combinations of ten binary inputs.
verification.four_state: Exhaust 4096 p1 input combinations and 256 p2 input combinations over 0,1,X,Z, with other group at zero.
verification.sampling: Sample one testbench time unit after each change to allow continuous assignments to settle; no clock timing is specified.
verification.completion: Fatal on mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Original specifies no explicit X/Z truth table; use standard Verilog AND/OR gate semantics. No binary functionality ambiguity.
